name: Darla Drilldozer
summary: Darla Drilldozer is an industrious goblin overseeing a resource operation out of Irontree Clearing in Felwood. Unfazed by the surrounding demonic blight, she focuses entirely on extraction, profit, and keeping heavy machinery running in a hostile wilderness.

sections.title: Industrial Ambition in a Blighted Forest
sections.body: While druids and rangers view Felwood as a tragic landscape to be healed or shunned, Darla Drilldozer sees it purely in terms of harvestable assets. Stationed at Irontree Clearing, she directs local drilling and logging ventures on behalf of goblin enterprise. Between malfunctioning mechanical rigs, aggressive wildlife, and tainted treants, Darla maintains a blunt, pragmatic approach: if something gets in the way of resource extraction, hire an adventurer to blow it up or oil it down.

faq.answer: Darla Drilldozer is a goblin supervisor stationed at Irontree Clearing in Felwood. She manages industrial operations in the blighted woods, directing logging, drilling, and mechanical upkeep for goblin profit.

faq.q: Why is there a goblin operation in Felwood?
faq.answer: Goblins care little about the demonic corruption that has ruined Felwood, so long as there are resources to exploit. Darla and her crew seek timber, oil, and useful minerals that others are too afraid or too reverent to harvest.

faq.q: What problems does Darla face at Irontree Clearing?
aliases: what is wrong at irontree clearing
faq.answer: Her machinery is constantly breaking down or running out of oil, and the corrupted local wildlife and Irontree treants frequently attack her workforce and equipment.

angles.text: Darla's camp is full of practical goblin engineering—drills, shredders, and specialized pumps running under the worst possible wilderness conditions.
For night elves seeking to restore Felwood, Darla's noisy, polluting logging rigs and irreverent exploitation of tainted treants are a grotesque affront to nature.
